meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Azure CLI 查你订阅里各项资源配额的上限、已用量和剩余可用量,能比较不同区域的可用容量,并代你提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你说出 “check quotas”、“service limits”、“quota exceeded” 等关键词,或要做部署规划、区域选择、容量验证时接管。

say.text: 对比 eastus2 和 westus2 的 vCPU 配额,哪个适合部署
say.note: 列出各区域的可用容量

say.text: standardDSv3Family 配额不够了,帮我提交提升到 500 的请求
say.note: 提交配额提升并查看审批状态

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses Azure CLI to look up each resource quota's limit, current usage and available capacity in your subscription, compare capacity across regions, and submit quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "check quotas", "service limits", "quota exceeded" and similar, or when planning a deployment, choosing a region, or validating capacity.

say_en.text: Check the remaining Microsoft.Compute quota in eastus
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage and available capacity

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quotas in eastus2 and westus2 for deployment
standardDSv3Family quota is too low — request an increase to 500
say_en.note: Submits the request and shows its status
